title: "PBS: Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme"
description: "Information about medicines provided to people under the Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme."

Information about medicines provided to people under the Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme.

*Explains the medicine subsidy program and links to listings, statistics and supporting information.*
